title: LegalEvent payload
description: Output of the PRD §40.7 `extractEvents(normalised)` boundary. Feeds the immutable corpus `legal_event` table. PRD §15.2: legal status MUST be derived from these evidenced events — cached status fields are not the authoritative history.

event_type.description: PRD §15.1 event taxonomy. NOT constrained to an enum here: packages/contracts publishes no `LegalEventType` family yet (Q-CRPS-4 / FND-03).

evidence_ref.description: The node version whose text evidences the event. Absence means the event is asserted without in-corpus textual evidence, which the CRPS-06 gates treat as an anomaly.

target_version_label.description: The document version the event acts upon, when it is not the emitting version.
